svg.title: The same standing wave driven near the closed end of the tube
svg.desc: Top: a tube of length L, closed at its left end, with its air in the fundamental mode: no displacement at the closed end and the most at the open end. The tube holds a quarter of a wavelength, λ/4; the rest of the wave, dashed, continues beyond the open end. Below: the same tube with a vibrating tuning fork held over a small hole near its closed end produces the same standing wave, again a quarter wavelength in the tube.
